scorer_commit: The score_context.py that ran is byte-identical to scripts/score_context.py at commit fd5eadf and at c041f44; the file has not changed between them.
written_by_hand: This run was made on a hosted notebook that holds no copy of the repository, so record_run.py could not record it. The manifest is assembled from what the notebook returned; node.json is the scorer's own account of its environment and its cells, and score.log is the slice of the runner's console log that belongs to this job.
host: Google Colab, free tier, Linux x86_64, Python 3.13.15
gpu: NVIDIA Tesla T4, 15.64 GB, CUDA 12.8, torch 2.11.0+cu128
command: python score_context.py 2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle --out-dir 2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle-scored-tabicl --models tabicl --chunk 20000, run by node_jobs.py from the unpacked job archive as job 9 of 18
session: Started in the first notebook session, which ended after context seed 20260911 was scored in full (twelve parts, the repeat check passed) and while the context of seed 20260912 was being read; resumed in the second session on a fresh virtual machine under another Google account, where the runner found every part of seed 20260911 present and skipped it, and seeds 20260912 and 20260913 were scored. node.json keeps the cell records of seed 20260911 from the first start; its wall_seconds and the wall in score.log cover the second start only. The runner recorded the job as finished at 2026-09-07T12:42:15+00:00 after 2240.5 s.
grid_index: experiments/2026-09-08-lc-grid-e-tabicl-colab-t4 holds the whole runner log, the job list, the runner's tally and the archive-level checks; this directory is one of the eighteen it indexes.

job_archive.built_by: scripts/pack_node_run.py over the nine bundles of arm E, as a zip for the notebook's upload cell (commit 1b13842, sidecars outoftime-run-grid-e-tabicl.zip.sha256 and .jobs.json beside it)
job_archive.score_context_py_provenance: Hash of the copy inside the archive, LF-ended; equal to scripts/score_context.py in this tree, unchanged since commit fd5eadf, and to the scorer of every earlier node run since experiments/2026-09-06-lc-2015h1e-probe3-colab-t4.

result_archive.name: outoftime-result-grid-e-tabicl.zip
result_archive.contents: 2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle-scored-tabicl/ (node.json, scores.parquet, reference.parquet, parts/) copied here unchanged; grid.log, jobs.json and jobs-done.json of the archive are in experiments/2026-09-08-lc-grid-e-tabicl-colab-t4

bundle_check.how: The hashes the scorer recorded in node.json for the bundle it read, equal to bundle.json of experiments/2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle. The scorer refuses a bundle whose hashes differ from bundle.json, so the notebook scored the recorded rows.

parts_check: 36 part files under parts/, one per (model, context seed, cell), equal to the 36 cell records of node.json; the parts concatenated are scores.parquet and reference.parquet row for row and probability for probability.

row_check.scored: 220,000 rows per context seed over 11 cohorts (2015Q3 to 2018Q1); every (cohort, row) pair, its outcome and its age match the gbm rows of experiments/2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-scores/scores.parquet, zero mismatches, no missing probability
row_check.reference: 50,000 rows per context seed; every row and its outcome match the gbm-50k reference of the same context seed in experiments/2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-scores/reference.parquet, zero mismatches

console_log: score.log is the runner's console output for this job: the scorer's own summary and the checkpoint download notice. It was read in full and holds no home path, no account name and no token.
question_this_run_was_sent_to_answer: The TabICL side of the expanding-arm grid (EXP-002, section 6 item 5 of the plan) on build 2015H1-E: the same three context draws the fifty-thousand-row control holds and every cohort the build scores, at the shipped settings, so that H1 to H3 are read on 11 cohorts of this build instead of the three of the falsifying run.

what_it_measured.model: tabicl 2.1.1, checkpoint tabicl-classifier-v2-20260212.ckpt (sha256 bdc7dbd5...4ed0) downloaded from Hugging Face by the library, tabpfn not installed
what_it_measured.context: 50,000 rows per context seed (20260911, 20260912, 20260913); every parameter at the library default (node.json): n_estimators 8, softmax_temperature 0.9, random_state 42, average_logits true; categorical columns passed as object dtype and not declared, since the estimator takes no categorical index
what_it_measured.chunk: 20,000 scored rows per forward call (--chunk 20000), so the 50,000-row reference cell ran in three calls; rows are scored independently and the chunking changes no probability
what_it_measured.cells: 11 cohort cells of 20,000 rows and one reference cell of 50,000 rows per context seed
what_it_measured.repeat: 2015Q3 scored twice from a fresh fit per context seed: largest absolute disagreement 0.0, no row differs, on every seed
what_it_measured.context_row_ratio_mean_pd_over_realised_: 20260911: mean pd 0.0153 over realised rate 0.0225, ratio 0.680; 20260912: mean pd 0.0158 over realised rate 0.0228, ratio 0.694; 20260913: mean pd 0.0165 over realised rate 0.0234, ratio 0.707

tuning_budget: Zero trials, no validation split, every parameter at the library default except those the command names. The classical models these rows pair with were tuned on their own pool (build.json of the build's score run), and the asymmetry runs both ways: the foundation model gets no tuning, the 50,000-row control inherits the point chosen on the full pool.
not_in_this_run: Softmax temperature 1.0, which is one scored cell in experiments/2026-09-08-lc-2015h1e-tabicl-t1-check-colab-t4 and derived rows for the rest. TabPFN, which is scored on the Apple node at both temperatures.
against_the_earlier_runs: The 180,000 scored rows and 150,000 reference rows this run shares with experiments/2026-09-06-lc-2015h1e-tabicl-colab-t4 (seed 20260911) and experiments/2026-09-06-lc-2015h1e-draws-colab-t4 (seeds 20260912, 20260913), scored on other T4 sessions, agree to the last bit: zero rows differ. The eight cohorts 2016Q2 to 2018Q1 are new.
